decisions.inventory: 968 explicit rows across nine collector families: base 300, directly catalogued PMG 297, Gem Masters 300, five regular insert families totaling 70, and pack-issued Drew /35 autograph. Three disputed PMG checklist cards are not manufactured by copying base rows. Keep unreleased until scope conflict resolved.
decisions.pmgDiscrepancy: Current TCDB PMG family has 297 cards #1–297. BCP, indexed Beckett and CC describe 300, including checklists, and CC enumerates #298–300. No physical scan or authoritative explanation resolved conflict. Exclude these three disputed rows from import; preserve their exact alternate catalog entries in source/audit. This is an explicit checklist verification gap, not proof they do not exist. Do not claim every possible PMG verified.
decisions.subsets: Base and parallels retain Caught on the Fly #233–247; Building Blocks #248–272; MLPD #273–297; Checklist #298–300 where actually catalogued. These are parts of the numbered collector checklist, not additional duplicate insert families. MLPD gold foil is a base design, not itself a PMG parallel.
decisions.rookies: No verified true RC in base: canonical tags, separately retrieved rookie index and full BCP/CC checklists have no RC marks. Building Blocks and Neophytes are thematic labels, not grounds for false RC. No inferred RC tags on parallels or Drew autograph.
decisions.teams: Complete source teams on all 968 rows, including player-specific checklists. Preserve 1998-era on-card affiliations, not later 1999 rosters: Clemens Toronto, Randy Johnson Houston, Mo Vaughn Boston, Albert Belle Chicago White Sox. Neophytes #7 Konerko says Chicago White Sox while pictured in Reds uniform; base #111 and its parallels retain Cincinnati Reds.
decisions.numbering: Preserve printed/catalogued card numbers, including mixed insert suffix spacing: NP/BW/PM use a space, DS/LP do not. Drew autograph uses actual SAMPLE identity. Player names retain clean canonical punctuation; remove only whole trailing tokens FLY/BB/MLPD/CL/SN/AU into metadata.
decisions.autograph: Include the documented pack-issued J.D. Drew autograph /35 from the TCDB Inserts section, independently confirmed by BCP and indexed Beckett. Embossed autograph authentication seal and hand numbering. The unsigned six-card sample sheet and /325 Hawaii Trade Conference signed sheet (and hand-cut singles) are promotional issues and excluded. No /325 autograph family or unsigned SAMPLE cards in this pack pool.
decisions.parallels: PMG /50 and Gem Masters 1/1 are separate holographic foil parallel families, with every actual source row independently fetched; no extra hologram checklist inferred. Preserve verified runs in variant, not player.
decisions.pack: Hobby default: eight cards per pack, 24 packs per box, single series, confirmed by original pack/box scans. Retail 20-pack boxes and 8+1 bonus-pack blasters are different formats and not this default. Existing VCS independent hit rolls replace base slots; no promise of historic card position or exact collation.
decisions.odds: Only verified five regular insert rates enabled: Neophytes 6, Boyz 18, Planet 36, Diamond Soul 72, Linchpins 360. PMG, Gem Masters and Drew /35 insertion denominators unknown, so null; serial print runs do not establish pack rates. Unknown families remain staged for pricing/images but inactive in pack pulls until QA. Odds belong only to ProductSet fields.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing/image harvesting. PMG checklist scope, rare odds, pack QA, images and prices pending. No production DB changes or deployment.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Full collector checklist #1–300, including all subsets and three player-specific checklist cards. No subset/rarity split.

productSets.name: Precious Metal Gems
productSets.notes: 297 directly catalogued PMGs #1–297, all /50, Hobby exclusive. Guides claim 300 but current TCDB omits checklist cards #298–300. Disputed three excluded pending evidence; not a definitive 297-card completeness claim. Unknown odds null.

productSets.name: Gem Masters
productSets.notes: All 300 source-catalogued one-of-one Gem Masters, including three player checklist cards. Each independently retrieved from own namespace and checked against base. Unknown odds null.

productSets.name: Neophytes
productSets.notes: Full fifteen-card insert checklist, 1:6. #7 Paul Konerko identifies Chicago White Sox despite Cincinnati uniform; preserve source/on-card affiliation.

productSets.name: Boyz With the Wood
productSets.notes: Full fifteen-card foldable insert checklist, 1:18. Folded display state is not a separate printed parallel.

productSets.name: Planet Metal
productSets.notes: Full fifteen-card holographic foil die-cut insert checklist, 1:36.

productSets.name: J.D. Drew Autograph
productSets.notes: SAMPLE J.D. Drew: authenticated, hand numbered /35, randomly packed out. Distinct from Hawaii promo /325 sheets/hand-cut singles; those excluded. No invented insertion odds.
